svg.title: Chignolin structure and mutation-dependent unfolding kinetics
svg.desc: Panels from Figures 1a and 2a of Guiding Peptide Kinetics via Collective-Variable Tuning of Free-Energy Barriers. Left: the chignolin structure with backbone-distance descriptors. Right: wild-type residue importance versus mutation-dependent changes in unfolding time. The panels are excerpted and arranged side by side; the original scientific data and axes are unchanged.
